issues.description: The data sheet states Stata was used and the appendix describes primary and companion tests, but the package inventory contains no Stata analysis program or final analysis dataset. Full-pipeline analyses cannot be run from this release; the bank-ID list is not an analysis dataset.
Step 1 reads and rewrites s1424 to form lta and lt1rcapr, but no earlier producer for s1424 appears in the supplied sources. Its intended role and schema are unknown.

The create macros write LARS_U&year._rssdhh, then read LARS_U&year._rssdhh2 from itself; later conforming-limit code requires _rssdhh2. No producer for that table is supplied, so clarify whether an upstream input or omitted step is required.

The final LAR keep list requests per_capita_income and unemploy_rate, while the bank table retains hlr; no source/merge or construction for these fields appears in supplied source texts. Their geographic, unit and period contracts are unknown.

The Y9C comment describes a 1995–2004 provision benchmark, while the Step 1 input comment states 2003Q4–2014Q4 and code computes means from available k4 rows without a visible 1995–2004 filter. Confirm the intended benchmark window and complete history; do not infer a start year from estimation dates.
The final rename source alias is truncated relative to the produced and joined secuob_r_win99positive_allyrs variable; the supported one-line correction is linked in ACT013.

Preparation files use F:, E:, C: and M: paths for libraries, raw files, the limits workbook and export. No author directory-to-workspace mapping is supplied. Producers and consumers need shared paths, and Step 1 plus Step 2 outputs must exist before Step 3.

Step 1 and Step 3 call the winsorization macros without an explicit include. The supplied file defines them; its b1 lines are explicitly labeled examples and should be excluded from the production macro load.

review_notes: Assessment covers the four supplied SAS source files and the author data sheet. The release contains substantive preparation code but no Stata analysis program or final analysis dataset.
No analysis_only scope is supported: the sample-bank XLSX is an identifier list, while the final loan-level analysis dataset is produced only by SAS code and is not packaged.
All 55 frozen dependency IDs are reviewed. Additional raw XPT, HMDA fixed-width and table-schema contracts are derived from code; missing producers remain explicit.
Official-source routes are credited only at supported product level. Catalog misses and unknown route availability are not evidence of no access or no license.
SAS availability remains unverified after the existing bounded empty-session TKELS startup failure; author code, regressions and datasets were not executed.
